title: Create and view an invoice
description: Verifies that a finance user can create an invoice and open it to confirm the saved details are available.

steps.description: Navigate to the invoice creation page
Fill in the client name field with Acme Corp
Fill in the amount field with a valid positive amount
Fill in the due date field with a valid future date
Submit the invoice form
Open the newly created invoice
Verify the invoice details are displayed

title: Scan a receipt and create an expense
description: Verifies that a user can scan a receipt with OCR, review extracted fields, and create an expense from them.

steps.description: Navigate to the expense creation page
Upload a receipt image for OCR extraction
Review the extracted expense fields
Submit the expense form using the extracted fields
Verify the new expense is displayed

title: Verify the service health check reports the app is live
description: This test verifies that the health endpoint returns the expected live service status for operational monitoring.

steps.description: Navigate to /health
Verify the service reports an ok status
Verify the finance service name is displayed

title: Add and update an invoice line item
description: Verifies that a user can add a line item to an invoice and then revise its quantity successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to the invoice creation page
Fill in the client name field with Acme Corp
Fill in the amount field with a valid positive amount
Fill in the due date field with a valid future date
Submit the invoice form
Open the invoice line item editor
Add a line item with a description, quantity, and unit price
Edit the added line item's quantity
Verify the updated line item is displayed

title: View dashboard summary metrics
description: This test verifies that a user can open the dashboard and see the current financial summary metrics.

steps.description: Navigate to /dashboard
Verify financial summary metrics are displayed
Verify profit information is displayed

title: Create and inspect a budget
description: Verifies that a user can create a budget and view it in the budget list with status information available.

steps.description: Navigate to the budget creation page
Fill in the category field with a valid spending category
Fill in the monthly limit field with a valid positive amount
Fill in the year field with a valid year
Fill in the month field with a valid month
Submit the budget form
Open the budget list or status view
Verify the new budget is displayed
Verify budget utilization information is displayed

title: Update and delete an expense
description: Verifies that a user can correct an expense and then delete it from the system.

steps.description: Navigate to the expense creation page
Fill in valid expense details
Submit the expense form
Open the saved expense
Edit the amount or vendor details
Save the updated expense
Delete the expense
Verify the expense is no longer available

title: Review dashboard trend data
description: This test verifies that a user can view the dashboard trend data and see time-based financial trends.

steps.description: Navigate to /dashboard
Click the trend data view
Verify trend data is displayed
Verify multiple time periods are represented

title: Update budget limit and refresh utilization
description: Verifies that a user can increase an existing budget limit and see updated budget status information.

steps.description: Navigate to the budget creation page
Create a budget for a category and month
Open the created budget
Edit the monthly limit to a higher value
Save the budget changes
Open the budget status view
Verify the updated budget is displayed
Verify refreshed utilization information is displayed

title: Accept suggested invoice items
description: Verifies that a user can request invoice item suggestions and add accepted suggestions to the invoice.

steps.description: Navigate to the invoice creation page
Fill in the client name field with Acme Corp
Fill in the amount field with a valid positive amount
Fill in the due date field with a valid future date
Submit the invoice form
Open the invoice item suggestion flow
Request suggested line items
Accept one of the suggested line items
Verify the accepted line item is displayed in the invoice

title: Get a financial forecast from the forecast endpoint
description: This test verifies that a forecast can be retrieved and projected financial results are shown to the user.

steps.description: Navigate to /api/v1/forecast
Verify projected revenue is displayed
Verify projected expenses and profit are displayed

title: Generate and delete an invoice reminder draft
description: Verifies that a user can generate a reminder draft for a sent or overdue invoice and then delete that invoice.

steps.description: Navigate to the invoice creation page
Fill in the client name field with Acme Corp
Fill in the amount field with a valid positive amount
Fill in the due date field with a valid future date
Submit the invoice form
Change the invoice status to sent or overdue
Request a payment reminder draft
Delete the invoice
Verify the invoice is no longer available

title: Generate a monthly summary report
description: This test verifies that a user can generate a monthly financial summary report for a selected period and see the report content.

steps.description: Navigate to /reports
Select a valid month
Select a valid year
Generate the monthly summary report
Verify a monthly summary report is displayed
Verify executive summary content is displayed

title: Send a financial question to the chat assistant and view the reply
description: This test verifies that a user can submit a financial question and receive an assistant response in the conversation view.

steps.description: Navigate to /api/v1/chat
Fill in a financial question in the message field
Submit the message
Verify an assistant response is displayed
Verify the conversation includes the sent message

title: View persisted chat history after sending a message
description: This test verifies that sent chat messages are saved and appear in the message history.

steps.description: Navigate to /api/v1/chat
Fill in a financial question in the message field
Submit the message
Open the chat history view
Verify the recent conversation history is displayed
Verify the sent message appears in history

title: Categorize and review an expense anomaly
description: Verifies that a user can get a suggested category, save an expense with it, and open an anomalous expense for review.

steps.description: Navigate to the expense creation page
Enter an expense description and vendor details
Request a suggested category
Select the suggested category
Submit the expense form
Open the anomaly review page
Open an anomalous expense record
Verify the expense detail is displayed for review

title: Compare forecast projections with current dashboard totals
description: This test verifies that forecasted values can be viewed in relation to the current financial summary for comparison.

steps.description: Navigate to /api/v1/forecast
Verify forecasted financial values are displayed
Verify dashboard comparison data is displayed

title: View client profitability ranking
description: This test verifies that a user can open client profitability analysis and see a ranked list of clients.

steps.description: Navigate to /clients/profitability
Verify a ranked client profitability list is displayed
Verify profitability metrics are displayed for clients

title: Continue a chat with a follow-up question using existing history
description: This test verifies that a follow-up message can be sent after prior conversation and the assistant responds with context preserved.

steps.description: Navigate to /api/v1/chat
Fill in an initial financial question in the message field
Submit the message
Fill in a follow-up financial question in the message field
Submit the message
Verify multiple messages are present in the conversation
Verify the follow-up assistant response is displayed

title: See refreshed forecast after new financial data is added
description: This test verifies that forecast projections update after recent invoice and expense activity is present.

steps.description: Navigate to /api/v1/forecast
Verify forecasted financial values are displayed
Verify the projections reflect recent financial activity

title: Refresh client rankings after new activity
description: This test verifies that a user can see client profitability rankings update after recording new invoice activity in the same session.

steps.description: Navigate to /clients/profitability
Verify a ranked client profitability list is displayed
Navigate to /dashboard
Verify dashboard financial summary metrics are displayed

title: Upsert an existing budget
description: Verifies that creating a budget for an existing category and period updates the existing budget and refreshes status.

steps.description: Navigate to the budget creation page
Create a budget for a category and period
Create another budget for the same category and period with a different limit
Open the budget status view
Verify the budget reflects the latest limit
Verify the utilization information is refreshed

title: Handle an empty dashboard state
description: This test verifies that a user can view the dashboard when there is no activity and see an empty or zeroed summary and trends.

steps.description: Navigate to /dashboard
Click the trend data view
Verify an empty or zeroed trend state is displayed
Verify financial summary metrics are still displayed

title: Review a forecast when historical data is limited
description: This test verifies that the forecast still renders with reduced-confidence projections when limited history is available.

steps.description: Navigate to /api/v1/forecast
Verify a forecast response is displayed
Verify reduced-confidence projection details are displayed

title: Delete a budget and confirm it is removed
description: Verifies that a user can delete a budget and no longer find it in the budget list afterward.

steps.description: Navigate to the budget creation page
Create a budget for a category and period
Delete the budget
Open the budget list
Verify the budget is no longer listed

title: Open a client from profitability analysis
description: This test verifies that a user can select a client from the profitability ranking and inspect its follow-up analysis view.

steps.description: Navigate to /clients/profitability
Select a client entry
Verify the selected client analysis is displayed
Verify client profitability details are visible

title: Handle missing invoice records
description: Verifies that a user sees a not-found state when opening or editing an invoice that does not exist.

steps.description: Navigate to the invoice lookup page
Open a non-existent invoice
Attempt to edit the same non-existent invoice
Verify a not-found message is displayed

title: Handle missing expense records
description: Verifies that a user sees a not-found state when opening or editing an expense that does not exist.

steps.description: Navigate to the expense lookup page
Open a non-existent expense
Attempt to edit the same non-existent expense
Verify a not-found message is displayed

title: Handle an empty client profitability view
description: This test verifies that a user sees an empty state when no client profitability data is available.

steps.description: Navigate to /clients/profitability
Verify an empty state message is displayed
Verify no client profitability records are displayed

title: Handle missing budget records
description: Verifies that a user sees a not-found state when updating or deleting a budget that does not exist.

steps.description: Navigate to the budget lookup page
Open a non-existent budget
Attempt to update the same non-existent budget
Attempt to delete the same non-existent budget
Verify a not-found message is displayed

title: Reject invalid invoice input
description: Verifies that invalid invoice data is blocked and no invoice appears in the list afterward.

steps.description: Navigate to the invoice creation page
Leave a required invoice field empty or enter an invalid value
Submit the invoice form
Open the invoice list
Verify a validation error is displayed
Verify no invalid invoice is listed

title: Reject invalid expense input
description: Verifies that invalid expense data is blocked and only valid expenses remain available afterward.

steps.description: Navigate to the expense creation page
Enter an invalid category or malformed date
Submit the expense form
Open the expense list
Verify a validation error is displayed
Verify only valid expenses are listed

title: Keep chat history unchanged after submitting an invalid empty message
description: This test verifies that an empty chat submission is rejected and no new conversation entry is added.

steps.description: Navigate to /api/v1/chat
Open the chat history view
Submit an empty message
Verify a validation error is displayed
Verify the chat history remains unchanged

title: Recover from an invalid report month
description: This test verifies that a user sees validation feedback for an invalid report month and can successfully generate the report after correcting it.

steps.description: Navigate to /reports
Select an invalid month value
Generate the monthly summary report
Verify a month validation error is displayed
Select a valid month
Select a valid year
Generate the monthly summary report
Verify a monthly summary report is displayed

title: Reject invalid budget input
description: Verifies that invalid budget values are blocked and do not create a new budget entry.

steps.description: Navigate to the budget creation page
Leave a required field empty or enter an invalid monthly limit
Submit the budget form
Open the budget list
Verify a validation error is displayed
Verify no invalid budget is listed

title: Generate the same monthly summary more than once
description: This test verifies that a user can generate a monthly summary report repeatedly for the same period and still receive a valid report each time.

steps.description: Navigate to /reports
Select a valid month
Select a valid year
Generate the monthly summary report
Verify a monthly summary report is displayed
Generate the monthly summary report again
Verify a monthly summary report is displayed
